findings.text: The rewritten island test forms its own `resolution` from the kernel's PERSISTENCE_ULP_FLOOR and the same found.jet.value levels, so `assert persistence < resolution` moves with the implementation rather than an independent source, and the refusal assertions at :153-154 hold under both the old per-cell enclosure and the new ULP criterion (the island is refused either way). The node's own diff therefore carries no assertion that fails if kernel.py reverts to the enclosure; that guard is the peer-owned item 39, red only under the negative control.

The fragment quotes the item-42 batch MaxRSS as 267869080K while docs/research/axis-persistence-near-saddle.html and the manifest both quote 267889856K for the same measurement; one metric is stored two ways in the landed evidence.

The diff adds this figure, which is outside the four write paths the brief enumerates (kernel.py, test_axis_ranking.py, docs/research/..., docs/evidence/fragments/...); it is justified by the repository figure mandate and correctly served by project-absolute src, but it is not a path the brief named.

The baseline_suite and after_suite `command` fields record `-m slow-or-not-slow` while the gate logs' own CMD headers record `-m "slow or not slow"`; the stored pair names a markexpr that is not runnable as written and does not match the command the logs show, so a promotion reading the command literally runs nothing.

The brief required both suite arms as ONE sbatch job on --partition=sirius with --time=04:00:00 --cpus-per-task=12 --mem=96G; the landed gate is a union of jobs 1290236 (96G then 256G) and 1290363, and the logs record no partition, so the single-job shape and the named sirius lane cannot be confirmed from the record. The measurement itself is sound (only item 39 differs between the arms).

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 6dbbb251a; four commits touch five files, of which kernel.py (the criterion swap) and test_axis_ranking.py (the island test rewritten to the ULP criterion) are the substance and the two HTML records plus the SVG figure are the evidence input.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py::test_census_keeps_the_wall_contact_saddle_across_the_adjacent_pair; the manifest records the base half failing by name (focused_tie_base.log, EXIT=1, axis=[nan nan]) and the head half passing in suite_after.log, and the negative control (negative_control.log, EXIT=1) restores the enclosure and reddens it, so the gate asserts the measure.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to admit the magnetic axis at the 282-cell tie pair while keeping the island rejection; scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/kernel.py:271-279 in the landed head replaces the per-cell enclosure with the pair's own level resolution and the tie pair is admitted.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it reports the fix committed at 624d803cf, both four-target arms killed at item 42 (OOM at both revisions), items 43-54 passing at both, and the negative control red, with baseline_suite and after_suite carried as completed:false.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares kernel.py, test_axis_ranking.py, docs/research/axis-persistence-near-saddle.html and docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/axis-persistence-near-saddle.html; every code and record path in the diff is inside them, with the added figure under docs/figures the one path outside the brief's enumeration.

justifications.durability: The regression guard is tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py::test_census_keeps_the_wall_contact_saddle_across_the_adjacent_pair, which the negative control (negative_control.log) proves red under the restored enclosure, but the node's own rewritten assertion at scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/test_axis_ranking.py:151 moves with the kernel and cannot catch the revert.
justifications.evidence: The gate measures the done_when (item 39 red at 6dbbb251a in focused_tie_base.log, green at 624d803cf in suite_after.log) and is recorded, but the arms never complete and the manifest's baseline_suite command at manifest.md:22 is not the command the logs ran.
justifications.fit: The change uses the surrounding jnp idiom, adds one module-level constant beside the existing helper, and rewrites the psi_rounding_enclosure docstring in place with no plan, ticket or plan-label name (kernel.py:213-217).
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/kernel.py:271-279 swaps the per-cell enclosure for PERSISTENCE_ULP_FLOOR times eps times max(|level_axis|,|level_saddle|), which admits the tie pair and keeps the island refusal, exactly the goal.
justifications.reuse: The change edits the capability owner scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/kernel.py in place and no repository owner of a persistence-resolution mechanism exists; the search over nova/equilibrium and the prototype trees found none, and psi_rounding_enclosure is kept and still used by scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/saddle_admission_probe.py:46.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every changed path is inside the declared write paths except docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/axis-persistence-near-saddle/level-resolution.svg, which the brief's four-path enumeration omits, and the diff carries nothing unrelated to the goal.
